recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17013 unless a future work group decision reopens modifierExtension wording more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-17013 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for STU3 BackboneElement asking to change the modifierExtension short description from "Extensions that cannot be ignored" to "Extensions that cannot be ignored if unrecognized".
initial_application: Jira comment svn revision 14307 corresponds to git commit 0d9b4892f49330249b4b7bbf0a83e6a638c14f1e, which changed source/datatypes/backboneelement.xml to the requested "if unrecognized" wording.
additional_context: FHIR-18039 later revisited the same phrase, was Published/Persuasive, and resolved to use "Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized". Commit f646f1c4433d5ec3d7c09da406d0497c2142b091 applied that later wording, current BackboneElement and BackboneType source carry it, and FHIR-18039 is already represented on the combined branch by commit a73f49d1f457374eb7f40b475e346d382e9ee632.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source intentionally differs from the exact FHIR-17013 intermediate wording because a later final Jira decision refined it, and the later wording is already present in the seed artifact and its current BackboneType parallel.

related_jiras.note: Directly refined the FHIR-17013 phrase from "if unrecognized" to "even if unrecognized" and is already audited on the combined branch.
